correctness.rationale: L0 uniform cycle-corona eigenchannels have disjoint strictly ordered vertical branches; even cosine subspace has simple spectrum and w=e(u0)-e(v0) overlaps every positive even eigenvector. For c!=b, secular rank-one update shifts every positive even eigenvalue away from unchanged odd eigenvalues; zero stays simple by connectivity. PBH gives exact sine-zero gcd obstruction and H_s(z) secular exceptions. H_s is nonzero rational by the shortest-path term of its Laurent expansion; exceptional set finite. Exact modular/rational Kalman ranks checked in packaged script, including 5-cycle genuine exceptional weight.

value.rationale: The theorem gives an exact arithmetic count and placement rule for generically viable single-vertex actuators on an infinite, structurally natural family of uniformly attached cycle networks after perturbing one prescribed leaf conductance. An explicit special-defect value forces control failure even at otherwise eligible locations, separating permanent reflection obstructions from isolated spectral resonance and making the exact finite exclusion necessary for safe actuator design.
